realInteraction: 3-step sequence: click "OPEN DRAWER" button (.uniqControl) -> drag .drawerCard DOWN >55px -> click "CLOSE DRAWER". Card shows cursor:grab in step 0 but is not draggable yet (misleading affordance). Verified 0->25%.

realInteraction: Press-and-HOLD .uniqControl ~1.2s+ without moving (onPointerDown/onPointerUp on the button; pointerup off the button is lost, taps do nothing). Verified still-hold 1.5s 0->17%.

realInteraction: Drag each .knot (k0->k1->k2 in order); taps do nothing. Knot k2 is covered by the word card at its centre. Verified hold+drag 0->20%.

name: MICROSCOPE
guideText: MICROSCOPE · LIVE GUIDE | How to play | Zoom out | MIND BEND | Focus changes proportion.
realInteraction: Tap .focusKnob 4 times (tapStep(4)); progress only moves on the 4th tap, so 3 taps look broken. Verified 4 clicks 0->17%.

name: SPOTLIGHT
guideText: SPOTLIGHT · LIVE GUIDE | How to play | Move the light | MIND BEND | Attention is lighting, not truth.
realInteraction: Drag .spotLamp sideways >110px, BUT the word card (.uniqWord) sits on top of the lamp centre and swallows the pointer; only the uncovered top strip of the lamp is grabbable. Verified drag from top strip 0->17%.

realInteraction: Click .cropHandle h0 -> h1 -> h2 -> h3 in order (only the current one is enabled). Verified 0->17%.
